blueprint.summary: Finds local organizations that publish sponsor pages, keeps only pages whose sponsor links pass equity, and ranks them by domain strength and cost. Use it to build local links for a site in one city, and rerun it per city.
use_when: You need local, topically neutral backlinks for a city-specific site
You can spend a small budget per link
avoid_when: You need links fast at scale
The site is not tied to one place

inputs.name: city
inputs.note: Add nearby suburbs as extra runs

inputs.name: budget_per_link
inputs.note: Used to drop tiers you won't pay for

steps.do: Search for local sponsor pages with footprints such as the city plus sponsors, our sponsors or become a sponsor.
steps.check: Each result is an organization's own sponsor page
gotchas: Skip news posts, social posts and documents: they rarely carry a lasting followed link

steps.do: Open each page's raw HTML and record the rel attribute of every sponsor link.
steps.check: Every target has link_rel recorded from HTML, not from a text reader
gotchas: Text readers and search snippets drop rel attributes
Plain-text sponsor listings carry no link at all

steps.do: Drop links marked sponsored or ugc, and treat nofollow as no equity.
steps.check: Only followed links remain in tiers 1-2

steps.do: Pull domain strength for each remaining domain.
steps.check: Every row has a domain rating
gotchas: Pages on a platform subdomain inherit the platform's rating, not the organization's

steps.do: Rank into tiers by link type, domain strength and price.
steps.check: Tier 1 is followed, relevant and within budget
gotchas: A new sponsor page with no sponsors yet is an early opening: list it as an ask

pitfalls.issue: Paying for a sponsor tier that shows only a logo image with no link
pitfalls.fix: Confirm in writing that the tier includes a followed text or image link before paying

quality_bar: Every tier 1 target has a followed link confirmed from HTML
Each row has a next step
